{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below current prices during uptrends, showing 3-5 euro lag that gets absorbed into true outcomes",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), model underforecasts by 2-4 euros compared to true values",
    "Mean reversion bias: model continues extrapolating recent 1-2 day moves even when 3+ day consolidations occur",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive (0.00 → 0.67+) causes immediate 2-3 euro price recovery that model misses",
    "When price has been flat for 4+ days, model continues projecting yesterday's level instead of capturing base range stability",
    "Model overforecasts by 2-3 euros when sentiment turns negative (below 0.33), mispricing near-term price support resilience",
    "Effective forecast range is narrowed to 68-76 EUR during normal conditions, ignoring model's 65-85 EUR extrapolation"
  ]
}
